name: Match the Vehicle
tagline: Match each vehicle to a compatible space.
brief: Handle electric, large, and ordinary arrivals with specific rules.
context: The lot has standard spaces, charging bays, and wider spaces for large vehicles.
narrative:
The entrance queue now contains different vehicle requirements. An electric car should use a charging bay, and a large vehicle needs a large space.

A broad standard rule also matches those vehicles. Order the policy so special cases are handled before the general fallback.
objective: Serve all eight vehicles without assigning a vehicle to an incompatible category.
learningObjective: Match resources by requirements and place specific rules before a general fallback.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starter controller sends every arrival to standard parking. Add electric and large rules above that fallback.

The first matching safe rule decides the allocation for the vehicle at the head of the queue.
hint: Use this order: electric → charging, large → large, then the standard fallback.
hints: A broad hasWaitingVehicle rule also matches electric cars and trucks.
Specific rules must appear before the broad fallback in a top-to-bottom decision flow.
Use carElectric → park-charging, then carLarge → park-large, then hasWaitingVehicle → park-standard.
